title: Fixed tensor coefficient comparison
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme], let q:A→X, q1:B→X and a:B→A satisfy aq=q1, and let L be an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write P for tensor pullback and a* for ordinary module pullback. Using the fixed tensor adjunctions [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], conjugate pushforwardComp(a,q) followed by pushforwardCongr(aq=q1) to obtain c:P_q1≅P_q followed by P_a. Define d:a*(P_q L)≅P_q1 L as the inverse ordinary-to-tensor left-adjoint-uniqueness comparison at P_q L, followed by c_L inverse. This is exactly the coefficient identification formerly constructed locally in the original coefficient-transpose definition; it is real isomorphism data, not data from an unproved existence claim.

lean.statement: def tensorCoefficientComparison {A B X : Scheme.{v}} (q : A ⟶ X) (q1 : B ⟶ X) (a : B ⟶ A) (h : a ≫ q = q1) (L : X.Modules) : (pullback a).obj ((tensorPullback q).obj L) ≅ (tensorPullback q1).obj L
